description: Journey — while building or after: a packaged way to apply the same extension mechanisms (config, documents, hooks, reactions) as one separable unit — a variant to switch on, content added over the game, a game opened to its players' mods (an option of the developer). gripforge_game_audit then plays the modded game. The mods of a Game Kit project (gkp_…), docs/mods-engine.md: a mod (gripforge.mod/1) is data applied over the project before the kits mount — config keys and collection documents the kits declare moddable (configPatch by dotted path, data.<collection> { remove, patch, add, order }, hooks documents that tap decisions, scripts whose rules react to events) — whole or not at all, never code. The kits are built to be adapted without recoding them — interceptable (hooks), registrable (registries), modifiable (config, documents, patches) and reactive (rules on events that change data): that is the normal, recommended way to build a game, written in the project (see gripforge_game_engine points) or packaged as a mod. A mod packages those changes as one separable unit: a variant to switch on or off (a hard mode, a season event) without copying the project, content added over the game, and — an option of the developer — a game opened to its players' mods. action=list (default): the game policy (config.mods of game.engine: enabled, disabled, order, deny), every mod with its status (applied | disabled | refused) and issues ({ level, code, path, message }), the documents each added, the fingerprint the network handshake compares. action=validate { mod }: a dry run — the project with this mod added (or replacing the one with its id), applied as the host would: its status and issues, nothing written. action=install { mod }: writes it to the mods collection (validated against the mod schema). action=remove { id }. action=enable / disable { id }: the policy list mods.disabled. action=order { ids }: these mods first, in this order (a mod always comes after those it depends on). 0 credits.

action.description: list (default) | validate | install | remove | enable | disable | order.

id.description: remove, enable, disable: the mod id.

ids.description: order: the mods first, in this order.

mod.description: validate, install: the gripforge.mod/1 document ({ id, version, requires?, depends?, conflicts?, config?, configPatch?, data? }).

project_id.description: Game Kit project id (gkp_…). Not a dedicated-server project (gpj_…) nor a Library item.

workspace_id.description: Workspace authorized by the current key. Never infer another user’s workspace.
